title: WAIT Without Wasting Your Life
hook: Stuck? Do this while you wait on God.
script: Waiting isn’t wasting; it’s training. Try the W-A-I-T rhythm. Work what’s in your hand—show up faithfully with today’s small task (Luke 19:13). Align your mind with God’s will—renew it and trust His path over yours (Romans 12:2; Proverbs 3:5–6). Invest in people—stir up love, check on someone, serve quietly (Hebrews 10:24–25). Talk to God honestly—pray your questions like David did (Psalm 13). Seven days, one obedient step a day. God renews strength as you wait (Isaiah 40:31). You’re not stuck; you’re being shaped.

title: The 7-Day Wait Challenge
hook: If God feels silent right now, watch this.
script: When nothing moves, faithful waiting moves you. For the next seven days, take one small obedient step each day. Clean one corner you’ve avoided. Read Romans 12:2 and ask, What mindset needs renewing? Call someone and encourage them. Pray Psalm 13 word-for-word. Do one task with excellence. Sit quietly and wait on the Lord, breathing Isaiah 40:31. End the week by thanking God for unseen work. Psalm 27:14 says, Wait for the Lord; be strong. When nothing changes outside, God changes you inside.

title: When Nothing Changes
hook: You need to hear this today: delay isn’t denial.
script: When life won’t budge, God hasn’t left you; He’s building you. Waiting in Scripture is active—hoping, trusting, obeying. Be faithful in little today: answer that email, bless a neighbor, open your Bible and pray, Lord, align me. Tell God the truth you’re carrying; He can handle it. Keep walking. James 1:2–4 says endurance makes you mature. Psalm 27:14 says wait for the Lord; be strong. Pray with me: Father, steady my heart, grow my endurance, guide my next step, and use this season for Your glory. Amen.
